title: AEPEnvelopeBase
description: Shared base properties for all AEP evidence envelope schemas. Not registered in the schema index — intended to be composed via $ref / allOf.

trace_id.description: Optional correlation ID linking related evidence records

created_at_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the record was created (envelope timestamp)

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata about the evidence record

signature.description: Optional tamper-evident signature over the record content
